title: 第9章 暗流汹涌三莲石门第10章 死鬼神像
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 王易在太一宗的任务大殿里兜兜转转，溜溜达达。
他里里外外转了一圈，发现殿内没什么像自己一样的闲人，太一宗弟子大都行色匆匆，进殿接取任务，然后不作停留，干净利落的转身离去。
没有一个人在意王易，没有一个人搭理过他。
“大家都这么忙吗？”
王易挑起眉头，渐渐发现了些不同寻常的地方。
整个太一宗都弥漫着一股紧张压抑的气氛，众多弟子凝神戒备，似乎每个人都压力很大。
王易追寻这股压力的源头，眼神扫过所有挂在头顶的任务竹筒。
他分析辨别，最后目光停留在了几个字的上面。
“西疆，邪道入侵。”
太一宗的任务大殿里，几乎有一半以上的任务都和西疆有关，而且字里行间提及了邪道入侵。
王易摸摸下巴，心中猜想：“看来这入侵西疆的邪道势头猖獗，给太一宗的压力不小。”
“宗内弟子都被派出门做任务了，那是不是意味着，此时的太一宗内部空虚，很容易发生意外？”
王易想到这里，脑海中不由得浮现出了木屋前的三个人影。
刘启元、王师兄，还有那个神秘恐怖的雀斑少年。
这三个家伙一定在酝酿着不可告人的巨大阴谋，勾结邪道，可能会波及整个太一宗。
“那我还在这儿杵着干什么？”
王易低声自语：“赶紧下山啊。”
万一在宗内被雀斑少年碰见，让他察觉到自己身上熟悉的鬼神之气，这事儿就麻烦了。
人家在勤勤恳恳的计划阴谋，自己误打误撞闯入局中，要是出了什么差错可不太礼貌。
“我走了。”
王易脚底抹油，从哪儿来回哪儿去，退回到了山脚下。
他表情认真，对陈清月说：“山上情况太复杂了。”
陈清月觉得魏千城死了，王师兄他们也遭遇了邪修的毒手。
但事实上，在宗门大殿内，她接下的那个任务已经圆满完成了。
“怎么会这样！？”
陈清月眉头紧蹙，觉得匪夷所思。
任务完成了？
可魏千城分明已经被大卸八块，分尸碎骨，那被送到太一宗的魏千城又是谁？
他到底是人是鬼？
王易在旁边添油加醋：“还有一件事，我不知道当讲不当讲。”
陈清月眼帘微动：“有话直说。”
“你之前和我讲过那个受害的王师兄，他好像也在山上，而且还活着，活得很好。”
王易这次没见到王天权，但不影响他张口就来。
王易向陈清月描述了王天权的长相特征，把这件事的诡异程度推向了另一个顶峰。
“王师兄还活着？”
陈清月低声呢喃，心中的怪异和警觉越来越浓。
“如此的话，这些人一定不愿意让我上山回宗，甚至可能派人堵在了山门口。”
王易对此表示认同，刘启元可不是闲着没事干才坐在凉亭里吹风的。
陈清月思索许久，权衡利弊，最后还是看向了那个耐心等候的少年。
“王易，你怎么看？”
王易笑了笑，说：“我们有三个选择。”
“说来听听。”
“上策不变，转身就走，远远的离开太一宗，什么事都不会发生。”
陈清月默默摇头，她不会选这条路。
content_en:
Wang Yi walked around and strolled around the mission hall of Taiyi Sect.
He walked around inside and out and found that there was no one like himself in the hall. Most of the Taiyi Sect disciples were in a hurry, entered the hall to receive their tasks, and then turned around and left neatly without stopping.
No one cared about Wang Yi, no one paid attention to him.
"Is everyone so busy?"
Wang Yi raised his eyebrows and gradually discovered something unusual.
The entire Taiyi Sect was filled with a tense and depressing atmosphere. Many disciples were on guard, and everyone seemed to be under great pressure.
Wang Yi traced the source of this pressure and glanced at all the task bamboo tubes hanging above his head.
He analyzed and discerned, and finally his eyes rested on a few words.
"Western Border, evil invades."
In the mission hall of Taiyi Sect, almost half of the missions are related to Western Xinjiang, and there are mentions of evil invasion in every line.
Wang Yi touched his chin and guessed in his mind: "It seems that the evil way invading Western Xinjiang is rampant and puts a lot of pressure on Taiyi Sect."
"All the disciples in the sect have been sent out to do tasks. Does that mean that the Taiyi Sect is empty at this time and accidents are prone to happen?"
When Wang Yi thought of this, the three figures in front of the wooden house appeared in his mind.
Liu Qiyuan, Senior Brother Wang, and that mysterious and terrifying freckles boy.
These three guys must be brewing a huge ulterior conspiracy, colluding with evil ways, which may affect the entire Taiyi Sect.
"Then what am I still doing here?"
Wang Yi whispered to himself: "Hurry down the mountain."
If the freckled boy encounters him in the sect and he notices the familiar spirit of ghosts and gods in his body, this will be troublesome.
He was diligently planning a conspiracy, but he stumbled into the situation by mistake. It would not be polite if something went wrong.
"I'm leaving."
Wang Yi rubbed oil on the soles of his feet and walked back and forth from where he came, back to the foot of the mountain.
…
With a serious expression, he said to Chen Qingyue: "The situation on the mountain is too complicated."
Chen Qingyue felt that Wei Qiancheng was dead, and Senior Brother Wang and the others had also suffered from the vicious hands of evil cultivators.
But in fact, in the sect hall, the task she took over had been successfully completed.
"How could this happen!?"
Chen Qingyue frowned, feeling incredible.
Mission accomplished?
But Wei Qiancheng had clearly been torn into eight pieces and his body was broken into pieces. So who was Wei Qiancheng who was sent to Taiyi Sect?
Is he a human or a ghost?
Wang Yi added fuel to the fire: "There is one more thing, I don't know whether to talk about it or not."
Chen Qingyue's eyes moved slightly: "If you have anything to say, just say it."
"You told me about the injured Senior Brother Wang before. It seems that he is also on the mountain, and he is still alive and well."
Wang Yi didn't see Wang Tianquan this time, but it didn't stop him from opening his mouth.
Wang Yi described Wang Tianquan's appearance and characteristics to Chen Qingyue, pushing the weirdness of this matter to another peak.
"Senior Brother Wang is still alive?"
Chen Qingyue murmured in a low voice, the weirdness and vigilance in her heart getting stronger and stronger.
"In this case, these people must not be willing to let me go up the mountain to return to the sect. They may even send people to block the entrance of the mountain."
Wang Yi agreed with this. Liu Qiyuan did not just sit in the pavilion and enjoy the breeze with nothing to do.
Chen Qingyue thought for a long time, weighed the pros and cons, and finally looked at the boy who was waiting patiently.
"Wang Yi, what do you think?"
Wang Yi smiled and said, "We have three choices."
"Tell me and listen."
"The best policy remains the same. Just turn around and leave. Leave Taiyi Sect far away. Nothing will happen."
Chen Qingyue shook her head silently, she would not choose this path.
